description: This file contains Bash shell scripting functions designed for logging and managing collapsible sections in GitLab CI/CD job logs. It provides utilities for logging errors, successes, informational messages, and creating collapsible sections in CI job outputs with start and end markers.

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs an error message in red color with an emoji prefix.

methods.name: log_success
methods.description: Logs a success message in green color with an emoji prefix.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs an informational message in yellow color with an emoji prefix.

methods.name: section_start
methods.description: Creates a collapsible section marker in GitLab CI logs with optional description and collapse state.

methods.name: section_end
methods.description: Ends a collapsible section in GitLab CI logs that was started with section_start.
